cards.title: Where did agents say they were confused?
cards.recipe: Search agent-authored text for a curated family of uncertainty phrases; group by phrase and repository; count distinct conversations as well as occurrences.
cards.preview: One highlighted excerpt above a short phrase ranking.
cards.eligibility: At least one exact match in agent text; exclude quoted user text and injected instructions where provenance permits.
cards.destination: Matched messages with surrounding turns and their conversations.
cards.exploration_value: Finds concrete moments worth clarifying in future instructions.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Add a canonical messages or phrase-match relation with role, message time, match family, source span and parent conversation.
cards.calculation_gap: Library find returns workspace membership; it cannot apply agent role and rolling time to the actual matched message through QueryState.
cards.performance_note: Use FTS before grouping; a recently active workspace can contain an old match and is not evidence of a recent phrase.

cards.title: What did I have to correct?
cards.recipe: Search human-authored messages for explicit corrections such as 'you misunderstood' and 'not what I asked'; rank recurring literal phrases and show context.
cards.preview: User correction paired with the immediately preceding agent response.
cards.eligibility: At least one correction phrase; label phrase matches rather than proven misunderstandings.
cards.destination: Correction messages and preceding agent turns.
cards.exploration_value: Makes repeated steering visible without claiming to read the user's mood.
cards.current_preview: Your messages containing explicit correction phrases.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose correction phrase families and bounded neighbor-message hydration; preserve genuine human authorship.
cards.calculation_gap: writing_messages can filter literal human corrections by sent_at; it cannot return the paired preceding agent response as a normal metric result.
cards.performance_note: Date-bounded LIKE is viable for a small window but an indexed message search route is better at archive scale.

cards.title: What instructions am I repeating?
cards.recipe: Normalize repeated human-authored instruction spans; cluster exact or near-exact repetitions across distinct conversations; separate templates and re-sent text.
cards.preview: Repeated sentence with a row of conversation marks.
cards.eligibility: A repeated span in at least three distinct conversations; confirm it is instruction text before naming it a rule.
cards.destination: Repeated spans grouped by conversation and repository.
cards.exploration_value: Suggests candidates for reusable instructions or skills.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract repeated instruction spans and versioned clusters; exact fingerprints can be deterministic, while identifying instructions or semantic similarity needs classification.
cards.calculation_gap: Existing message text and authorship can provide candidates, but normalized instruction spans and near-duplicate clusters are not a dataset.
cards.performance_note: Materialize cluster memberships and support counts; do not normalize every transcript on reload.

cards.title: How many exchanges does a task take?
cards.recipe: For each canonical conversation count genuine human-to-agent exchanges; aggregate median, upper quartile and distribution by repository and task family when available.
cards.preview: Compact histogram with median marker; a small repository comparison.
cards.eligibility: Several complete conversations with human participation; exclude automated launch messages and report unfinished sessions separately.
cards.destination: Conversation-level exchange counts and transcripts.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals the shape of collaboration rather than just message volume.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose conversation-level exchange facts, human/automation distinction, completion coverage and task-family labels when available.
cards.calculation_gap: Library turn_count and writing summaries are work-grain totals, not exact genuine exchanges per conversation in the selected period.
cards.performance_note: Distributions need per-conversation rows; alternatively group filtered message facts, then reduce the groups in a second stage.

cards.title: Where do conversations keep circling back?
cards.recipe: Classify repeated problem statements and alternating proposed fixes within each conversation; rank loops by number of returns and preserve supporting excerpts.
cards.preview: A three-step loop with repeated text highlighted.
cards.eligibility: Multiple evidenced returns to the same problem; similarity alone does not prove lack of progress.
cards.destination: Candidate loops with intervening turns and tool results.
cards.exploration_value: Finds topics whose explanation or diagnosis may need improvement.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Materialize evidence-backed loop episodes with repeated-topic links and intervening events.
cards.calculation_gap: No current metric or forthcoming scalar formula identifies semantic return-to-problem loops.
cards.performance_note: Query ranked episode facts; neither a histogram nor a repeated phrase alone establishes a loop.

cards.title: When do agents ask me to do their work?
cards.recipe: Classify agent requests for user action; distinguish useful decisions from requests to run commands, copy outputs or perform available routine actions.
cards.preview: Request excerpt with categories such as decision, command and information.
cards.eligibility: At least one classified request; capability availability requires evidence before calling a request avoidable.
cards.destination: Requests and the capabilities available in that session.
cards.exploration_value: Surfaces opportunities to reduce manual handoffs.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract agent requests, action type and capability evidence; retain uncertainty about whether the action was avoidable.
cards.calculation_gap: Phrase filters can find candidate requests, but available capabilities and avoidable handoffs are not classified rows.
cards.performance_note: Run extraction at indexing and filter its annotations; avoid expensive classification during card eligibility checks.

cards.title: Which conversations end with explicit positive feedback?
cards.recipe: Find human-authored approval or thanks phrases; count distinct conversations and distinguish task acceptance from politeness through context.
cards.preview: Short user quote with a strip of linked conversations.
cards.eligibility: At least one positive-feedback match; do not label it objective correctness.
cards.destination: Feedback messages and the preceding result.
cards.exploration_value: Balances friction cards with examples worth repeating.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Add positive-feedback/acceptance evidence with predecessor links; a literal-match-only card can ship earlier with an honest label.
cards.calculation_gap: Human-message phrase searches are possible now; acceptance versus politeness is not established by the filter.
cards.performance_note: Indexed literal candidates are inexpensive; classification can be cached by message hash and extractor version.

cards.title: Where did I change the goal midway?
cards.recipe: Identify explicit changes in requirements after work started; record the change point and summarize the original and revised request.
cards.preview: Two contrasting request fragments connected by a small pivot arrow.
cards.eligibility: An evidenced scope change; distinguish a changed goal from clarification of the same goal.
cards.destination: Before-and-after request messages and intervening work.
cards.exploration_value: Helps users understand what kinds of tasks need early alignment.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract explicit scope changes and link original and revised requests to canonical work.
cards.calculation_gap: The archive contains requests in order, but a goal-change relation and before/after pair do not exist.
cards.performance_note: Index changes once; Query Table can already filter and group the resulting annotations.

cards.title: Which tool calls fail most often?
cards.recipe: Group calls by tool, program, subcommand or MCP method; compute failure count and failures divided by observed calls; rank both volume and rate.
cards.preview: Three labeled bars with failed and total counts.
cards.eligibility: Error-bearing groups with usable denominators; preserve no-result and interrupted statuses separately.
cards.destination: Failed calls plus the complete call population for each group.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals tool reliability in a way users can immediately investigate.
cards.current_preview: The calls behind recurring tool failures.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Implement v2 SQLite/map execution and preserve call-grain versus daily-rollup measure semantics.
cards.calculation_gap: Current tool_calls supplies call_count and error_count; separate counts work, but an aggregate ratio is not a v0.5 metric.
cards.performance_note: SUM(error_count)/SUM(call_count) is enabled by v2; retain cube routing and minimum exposure before top-K.

cards.title: Which error keeps coming back?
cards.recipe: Group failed calls by normalized error signature; count distinct conversations and repositories alongside total failures.
cards.preview: A prominent error fragment with a repository dot strip.
cards.eligibility: A repeated signature in more than one call or conversation; exclude volatile IDs and paths from grouping.
cards.destination: All calls with the selected signature and their raw results.
cards.exploration_value: Finds one fix that may benefit many sessions.
cards.current_preview: Repeated error signatures, with the original calls.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Hydrate bounded raw error examples; keep signature normalization and mirror exclusion consistent.
cards.calculation_gap: Error signatures, timestamps, conversation IDs and repositories are already filterable/groupable and support distinct counts.
cards.performance_note: Group a bounded failed-call population; distinct conversation/repository counts may bypass sum-only summaries.

cards.title: What do agents do after a failure?
cards.recipe: Sequence calls after comparable failures; categorize unchanged retry, changed arguments, different tool and user intervention; measure next observed outcome.
cards.preview: Branching recovery path with counts on each branch.
cards.eligibility: Enough failure episodes with retained follow-up calls; unresolved tails remain unknown.
cards.destination: Failure episodes with their next calls and results.
cards.exploration_value: Exposes recovery strategies worth copying or improving.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose stream identity, stable event order, normalized actions and recovery episode facts.
cards.calculation_gap: Ordered calls exist in storage, but the metric contract cannot select the next relevant call or recovery episode.
cards.performance_note: Precompute episodes incrementally or use bounded ordered partitions; success tails and unfinished episodes remain explicit.

cards.title: Where do unchanged retries pile up?
cards.recipe: Normalize call arguments within each stream; find repeated equivalent failing calls before meaningful changes; aggregate excess attempts and their attributed cost.
cards.preview: Repeated command tiles with the changed attempt emphasized.
cards.eligibility: At least one repeated failure sequence; exclude polling, intentional sampling and status checks.
cards.destination: Retry sequences and argument differences.
cards.exploration_value: Makes repetitive dead ends obvious.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Normalize call arguments and identify retry episodes by stream; make attributable costs queryable before paging.
cards.calculation_gap: Equivalent command filters exist, but adjacency, normalized argument identity and retry streaks are absent.
cards.performance_note: Use stream/order indexes and cached episode facts, not a Cartesian self-join over the tool ledger.

cards.title: Which calls consume the most recorded waiting time?
cards.recipe: Rank commands by total measured duration and show median and upper percentile where per-call timing is available; split reported from timestamp-derived durations.
cards.preview: Horizontal duration bars with a marked long tail.
cards.eligibility: Sufficient timed calls; show timing coverage and do not describe timestamp gaps as pure tool runtime.
cards.destination: Timed calls with duration source and slow examples.
cards.exploration_value: Finds test suites, builds or requests that dominate recorded elapsed time.
cards.current_preview: Recorded elapsed time by command; includes approval waits.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Preserve duration_source and timed-call coverage; implement v2 distributions in SQLite or a prepared duration summary.
cards.calculation_gap: Total duration and maxima are queryable; median and p95 require distributions or additional scalar percentile support.
cards.performance_note: Exact quartiles/p95 scan or sort call samples; daily min/max/sum cannot reconstruct percentiles.

cards.title: What starts failing after a change?
cards.recipe: Compare error signatures and failure rates before and after an observed harness, tool configuration or project change; join by stable dimensions and exposure.
cards.preview: Before-and-after bars with a change marker.
cards.eligibility: Both periods have calls and comparable coverage; a change marker is association, not proof of cause.
cards.destination: Calls and recorded changes in the compared periods.
cards.exploration_value: Gives users a concrete lead when a workflow deteriorates.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose tool/harness/project change events and compatible exposures around each anchor.
cards.calculation_gap: Failure counts exist but the dated configuration-change anchors and aligned populations are not a generic query source.
cards.performance_note: Reuse indexed bounded period scans or event-relative facts; preserve versions and avoid automatic causal claims.

cards.title: Where do edits fail to apply?
cards.recipe: Filter edit-related file_not_read, edit_no_match, file_not_found and related errors; group by file, repository and edit mechanism.
cards.preview: File names beside small stacked error marks.
cards.eligibility: At least one edit-related failure with a resolved path or known tool.
cards.destination: Failed edits and the reads or changes preceding them.
cards.exploration_value: Finds stale context and fragile editing patterns.
cards.current_preview: Failed edit calls, grouped by repository path.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Hydrate failed-call details and preceding reads if the cover needs a sequence.
cards.calculation_gap: Existing call fields support edit-related error filters and grouping by repository, path or mechanism.
cards.performance_note: Timestamp and error/path indexes are useful; command-text predicates may require trigram filtering or a fallback scan.

cards.title: Which failures spread across repositories?
cards.recipe: For each error signature compute repository breadth, first and recent occurrence, and within-repository rates; rank errors common across otherwise different projects.
cards.preview: Small repository-by-error matrix.
cards.eligibility: A signature appears in at least two repositories with usable call populations.
cards.destination: Shared signatures split by repository and tool version when known.
cards.exploration_value: Distinguishes a shared environment problem from a local project issue.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Supply compatible call exposures and version/source coverage for each repository.
cards.calculation_gap: Distinct repositories by error signature is possible; exposure-normalized comparison and a failure heatmap are incomplete.
cards.performance_note: Distinct breadth plus counts can be computed from bounded calls; apply multi-repository eligibility before group limiting.

cards.title: Which outputs keep being paid for?
cards.recipe: Rank tool results by attributed context-carried tokens and API-equivalent context cost; retain the originating result and number of later requests.
cards.preview: One output source feeding repeated request marks.
cards.eligibility: Calls with retained results and usable carriage estimates; show estimation provenance.
cards.destination: Results ranked by context carried and attributed cost.
cards.exploration_value: Explains why a small early result can matter more than a large late one.
cards.current_preview: Tool output carried into later requests, in attributed tokens.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Persist or SQL-bind versioned per-call pricing components with provenance before sorting/aggregating.
cards.calculation_gap: carried_tokens and carried_requests are globally queryable now; per-call context cost is added only after page fetch.
cards.performance_note: Token ranking is indexable already; accurate dollar ranking needs a queryable priced fact rather than enrichment of a selected page.

cards.title: What floods the context window?
cards.recipe: Rank retained tool results by added tokens or bytes; group by command and include truncation and measured-versus-estimated provenance.
cards.preview: A few output blocks sized by added tokens, with a clipped-output marker.
cards.eligibility: At least one unusually large result relative to the user's own call distribution.
cards.destination: Large tool results and their original calls.
cards.exploration_value: Points to narrower searches and quieter commands.
cards.current_preview: Result tokens added by each tool; inspect the largest outputs.; Truncated tool outputs and the calls that produced them.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Preserve measured versus estimated token provenance and fetch only a bounded result excerpt.
cards.calculation_gap: Result bytes/tokens, source and truncation can be filtered or ranked now; a formal personal outlier threshold adds statistical work.
cards.performance_note: Existing result-token indexes help top rows; exact personalized percentile thresholds need a separate distribution pass.

cards.title: Which files get read again and again?
cards.recipe: Resolve canonical repository paths; count repeated reads within streams and across conversations; separate unchanged content from reads after edits when content identity is available.
cards.preview: File ranking with read marks distributed along a session strip.
cards.eligibility: Repeated resolved-path reads; only call them unchanged when content evidence supports it.
cards.destination: Read events for the selected paths and intervening edits.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals stable context that may be worth packaging or loading differently.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose agent stream identity and normalized read events; join content fingerprints and intervening edits for the unchanged variant.
cards.calculation_gap: Paths and read categories support counts; distinguishing within-stream repeats and unchanged-content rereads needs extra identity/evidence.
cards.performance_note: A path-by-stream count projection is cheap; content identity must be stored rather than inferred from matching file names.

cards.title: Where do agents search without finding anything?
cards.recipe: Identify explicit empty search results; cluster queries and count subsequent searches before the first retained match; keep valid no-match exit codes distinct from errors.
cards.preview: Search fragments stepping from empty to a found result.
cards.eligibility: Retained search outputs distinguish empty from missing results.
cards.destination: Search sequences and the successful or unresolved end.
cards.exploration_value: Shows discovery friction that ordinary error counts miss.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract explicit empty/found search outcomes and ordered search episodes, including result-count coverage.
cards.calculation_gap: Search queries exist, but a valid empty search outcome is not synonymous with status=error or no_result.
cards.performance_note: Query stored result-count/episode fields. Zero matches from rg should not be counted as a tool error.

cards.title: How long before the first meaningful action?
cards.recipe: Sequence each session from its first request to its first edit, test, decision or other task-appropriate action; show preceding reads and searches.
cards.preview: Session strips with the first selected action marked.
cards.eligibility: Complete event ordering; label first edit or first test literally unless task-specific meaning is classified.
cards.destination: Sessions ordered by time and events before the selected milestone.
cards.exploration_value: Helps inspect whether agents spend too much effort orienting themselves.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Create first-request/first-edit/first-test facts; classify meaning only for the richer meaningful-action version.
cards.calculation_gap: Calls have timestamps, but request-to-first-action milestones and task-appropriate action semantics are not exposed.
cards.performance_note: Materialize per-stream milestone durations with provenance; a metric over precomputed durations is straightforward.

cards.title: What happens around compaction?
cards.recipe: Compare events immediately before and after recorded compactions; count repeated reads, renewed searches and explicit re-explanations in matched windows.
cards.preview: Context trace with a compaction notch and repeated events on either side.
cards.eligibility: Recorded compactions with retained neighboring events; do not infer forgotten information merely from a reset.
cards.destination: Compaction episodes and their surrounding transcript windows.
cards.exploration_value: Makes the consequences of context resets inspectable.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose compaction events and linked ordered message/call windows, plus repeat-event facts.
cards.calculation_gap: Library compaction_count can select affected work but does not locate compactions or surrounding rereads.
cards.performance_note: Maintain a compact event index and derive bounded before/after windows per event, not all conversation text each refresh.

cards.title: Which instructions are loaded most heavily?
cards.recipe: Group retained skill or instruction bodies by content bytes and distinct streams; show known context attribution only when the parent event supports it.
cards.preview: A few named instruction blocks sized by retained content.
cards.eligibility: Retained instruction bodies with size evidence; avoid inventing file size or charging a workflow to a skill load.
cards.destination: Instruction loading evidence and retained bodies.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals what occupies context before task work begins.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose an instruction-load dataset with body size, identity, source type and parent event; deduplicate harness snapshots.
cards.calculation_gap: Skill content_bytes can be summed/ranked now; broader instruction bodies reside below Query Table and loading evidence has different grains.
cards.performance_note: Aggregate small load facts; carry costs only when the originating event supports them, avoiding double attribution across bodies.

cards.title: What do agents look at most?
cards.recipe: Combine resolved file reads, search queries, reached domains and skill loads; rank by distinct sessions and show concentration by repository.
cards.preview: A compact attention map of paths and sources.
cards.eligibility: Known event attribution; keep reads, searches and loads as distinguishable event types.
cards.destination: The ranked sources and every supporting access event.
cards.exploration_value: Gives users a surprisingly concrete portrait of agent attention.
cards.current_preview: Read calls by repository path, with their source evidence.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Normalize file reads, searches, URL visits and skill loads with source kind and canonical stream/session IDs.
cards.calculation_gap: Tool-call and skill tables each cover some attention events, but there is no unified typed source-event relation.
cards.performance_note: A prepared UNION-style host dataset can support ordinary grouping; distinct session counts prevent large outputs from dominating every ranking.

cards.title: Which tests fail repeatedly?
cards.recipe: Group observed test failures by normalized test or failure signature and command; include failure markers even when shell status was successful.
cards.preview: Test name and a red-green run strip.
cards.eligibility: Retained test-failure evidence; test identifiers require extraction from output.
cards.destination: Test calls with failure output and later passes when present.
cards.exploration_value: Finds recurring verification trouble that generic command status can hide.
cards.current_preview: Recorded test failures by command, ready to inspect.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Parse test-run summaries/identifiers and comparable test configuration; retain markers hidden by successful shell exits.
cards.calculation_gap: test_failure and normalized error signatures exist; exact test identifiers and a per-test run history require extraction.
cards.performance_note: Group a prepared test-results table instead of repeatedly parsing raw logs; a signature-based version can ship earlier.

cards.title: Which tests eventually turn green?
cards.recipe: Link comparable test runs within each stream; find failure-to-pass sequences and count intervening edits or attempts.
cards.preview: A failing run crossing into a passing run with edit ticks between.
cards.eligibility: Explicit comparable failure and pass evidence; a zero exit from an unrelated command is insufficient.
cards.destination: Recovery episodes with test identity, edits and results.
cards.exploration_value: Highlights successful debugging paths worth learning from.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Create test-recovery episodes with test identity, order, configuration, edits and observed pass.
cards.calculation_gap: Failing and passing calls can be filtered separately but the contract cannot pair comparable runs within a stream.
cards.performance_note: Use indexed run identity/order and update episodes incrementally; do not treat any later successful command as a recovery.

cards.title: Where are edits followed by verification?
cards.recipe: Within each work stream connect edit events to later related test, build or lint commands; aggregate coverage by repository and task family.
cards.preview: File or repository grid with verified, unobserved and unknown cells.
cards.eligibility: Retained edits and verification events; no retained test means no observed verification, not proof none occurred.
cards.destination: Edited work grouped by observed verification evidence.
cards.exploration_value: Helps inspect verification habits while preserving coverage limits.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Derive edit-to-check links and coverage states, with a conservative path/test relevance mapping.
cards.calculation_gap: Edit/test call categories exist; file relevance and after-edit verification links do not.
cards.performance_note: Materialize check coverage at work or edit grain; naive joining every edit to every later test is expensive and misleading.

cards.title: Which completions have no retained verification?
cards.recipe: Detect explicit agent completion claims and join them to observed checks after the last relevant edit; show claims without supporting retained checks.
cards.preview: Completion excerpt above a small empty check lane.
cards.eligibility: Explicit completion text plus usable event coverage; call it missing retained evidence rather than untested work.
cards.destination: Completion claims, final edits and all retained checks.
cards.exploration_value: Invites the user to verify claims against what actually happened.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract explicit claims and final relevant edits; join retained check evidence and source completeness.
cards.calculation_gap: Completion claims are transcript text, and missing retained checks cannot be inferred from a work outcome label alone.
cards.performance_note: Query annotated claim facts; keep no-observed-verification distinct from proved untested behavior.

cards.title: How many edit and test cycles does a fix take?
cards.recipe: Sessionize alternating edits and comparable verification runs; count cycles until an observed pass; show median and distribution per failure family.
cards.preview: Edit-test beads ending in a green mark.
cards.eligibility: Comparable runs with retained ordering; unresolved sequences remain separate.
cards.destination: Cycle histories and grouped cycle counts.
cards.exploration_value: Quantifies iteration without equating fewer cycles with better work.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Derive comparable edit/test cycle episodes and their observed terminal state.
cards.calculation_gap: No episode/cycle input exists; v2 histogram over calls would show call values, not edit-test cycles per fix.
cards.performance_note: Prefer cycle facts at episode grain; staged grouping then a distribution is another route once cycle boundaries are explicit.

cards.title: Which checks are skipped after the final change?
cards.recipe: Find completed work where the last relevant check preceded the final relevant edit; distinguish pass-before-edit from check-after-edit.
cards.preview: Timeline with final edit positioned after the last check.
cards.eligibility: Relevant edits and checks plus an observed end state; relevance may require file-to-test mapping or classification.
cards.destination: Final edit and check order for each matched work.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals a specific verification gap users can address.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Materialize final relevant milestone facts with completeness and task/file relevance.
cards.calculation_gap: Dates are retained but last relevant edit/check order and observed finish are not an available metric field.
cards.performance_note: A stored last-edit-versus-last-check flag is cheap to filter; establishing relevance is Pharos work.

cards.title: Does a faster check change the workflow?
cards.recipe: Compare edit-test cycles, measured waiting and outcomes before and after an observed test command or configuration change; stratify comparable tasks.
cards.preview: Paired distributions for check duration and cycle count.
cards.eligibility: Known change point, usable durations and both cohorts; do not claim the change caused downstream differences.
cards.destination: Work cohorts with commands, durations and evidence of completion.
cards.exploration_value: Turns local tooling changes into something users can inspect over time.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Supply dated configuration transitions and episode-level cycle/duration/outcome facts.
cards.calculation_gap: Check durations exist; versioned check changes, comparable task cohorts and cycle counts are missing.
cards.performance_note: Align period populations before comparing distributions; exact percentiles and matched cohorts need bounded plans.

cards.title: Which sessions show review-driven rework?
cards.recipe: Detect retained review comments or explicit feedback and link the following edits and checks; cluster recurring review topics.
cards.preview: Review fragment with a small chain of follow-up changes.
cards.eligibility: Retained review or correction evidence linked to subsequent work; merging is not a quality label.
cards.destination: Feedback, responding edits and their checks.
cards.exploration_value: Finds the requirements that are repeatedly discovered during review.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract or import review/correction events and link responding edits and checks.
cards.calculation_gap: Some review evidence and patches may be retained, but review-topic annotations and response links are not a dataset.
cards.performance_note: Index review episodes and topics once; ordinary table filters can then explore them without runtime NLP.

cards.title: Which files draw the most back-and-forth?
cards.recipe: Join canonical paths to conversation-level human exchanges, edit attempts and verification cycles; rank files while preserving their separate measures.
cards.preview: A file ranking with conversation and edit-cycle marks.
cards.eligibility: Resolved files with associated conversations; do not multiply conversation effort once per edit event.
cards.destination: Work involving each ranked file and its edit sequences.
cards.exploration_value: Finds areas that repeatedly require discussion and iteration.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose work-file membership with deduplicated conversation effort and file-level edit/cycle facts.
cards.calculation_gap: Calls and Library changed_files exist, but joining conversation effort to each file creates a grain/fanout problem.
cards.performance_note: Build one row per intended work-file membership; do not multiply human effort by the number of edit calls.

cards.title: Where do changes get undone?
cards.recipe: Detect exact reversals or explicit revert events in retained patches or linked diffs; summarize changed-back spans and elapsed intervals.
cards.preview: A short diff fragment with forward and reverse arrows.
cards.eligibility: Retained patch or Git evidence supports reversal; repeated file edits alone are insufficient.
cards.destination: Original changes, reversal evidence and surrounding conversation.
cards.exploration_value: Surfaces second thoughts and unstable approaches.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Parse exact reversal/revert evidence and link original and reversed changes with stable paths and timestamps.
cards.calculation_gap: Retained change sets can provide patches, but the Query Table datasets do not expose reversals.
cards.performance_note: Incrementally index reversals or explicitly linked Git reverts; compare stored patches outside homepage evaluation.

cards.title: Which files are repeatedly changed together?
cards.recipe: Build file co-change sets per canonical work; rank pairs by shared-work count and association after accounting for each file's frequency.
cards.preview: A small cluster of connected file names.
cards.eligibility: Repeated co-changes across distinct work; ignore generated-file bundles or label them separately.
cards.destination: Work touching the selected file pair or cluster.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals hidden coupling and likely companions to future edits.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Materialize sparse co-change edges and each file's marginal work count.
cards.calculation_gap: changed_files supports membership filtering, but not per-work pair generation and normalized pair association.
cards.performance_note: Pair generation is quadratic for large work sets; bound or exclude generated bundles and update edges incrementally.

cards.title: Where do small tasks turn into broad changes?
cards.recipe: Classify initial requests as narrow or broad; compare that scope to distinct files and directories changed, with examples of the largest expansions.
cards.preview: Initial request fragment opening into a branching file map.
cards.eligibility: An interpretable initial scope and linked change evidence; scope expansion can be legitimate.
cards.destination: Requests and their complete linked file sets.
cards.exploration_value: Helps users discover places where apparently local work has wide consequences.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Annotate initial scope and join canonical file/directory breadth with direct request evidence.
cards.calculation_gap: File breadth is counted, but initial request scope and expansion semantics are not classified.
cards.performance_note: Query stored request labels and changed-file counts; broad changes can be appropriate, so retain examples and task context.

cards.title: Which areas repeatedly trigger environment trouble?
cards.recipe: Group setup, dependency, permission and build failures by repository and directory; relate them to the observed command population.
cards.preview: Directory rows with distinct error signatures.
cards.eligibility: Error classes and paths with usable attribution; avoid claiming the directory caused the error.
cards.destination: Environment-related failures and affected work.
cards.exploration_value: Finds recurring setup friction worth documenting once.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose directory scope and relevant command populations, with stable environment-failure categories.
cards.calculation_gap: Existing error/path/repository fields provide candidates; normalized directories and compatible per-directory exposure require a projection.
cards.performance_note: Use indexed directory/error facts; derive directory identity once rather than repeatedly executing unsupported full-scope text transforms.

cards.title: Where are multiple agents touching the same files?
cards.recipe: Join time-overlapping agent streams and canonical edit paths; count overlap episodes and show actual conflict evidence separately.
cards.preview: Parallel lanes converging on the same file tile.
cards.eligibility: Reliable timestamps and shared resolved paths; overlap is not a merge conflict by itself.
cards.destination: Overlapping sessions and their recorded edits or conflicts.
cards.exploration_value: Makes coordination hotspots visible.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose canonical edit events, stream assignment and reliable observed intervals; add separate conflict facts.
cards.calculation_gap: Streams and timestamps exist below Query Table; same-file concurrent edit intervals are not exposed.
cards.performance_note: Sweep indexed intervals within path/stream groups; pairwise global joins are costly and overlap does not prove conflict.

cards.title: What work keeps reopening?
cards.recipe: Link explicit revisits, follow-up tasks or semantically similar requests to the same work area; separate intentional iteration from unresolved recurrence.
cards.preview: A timeline of related tasks with their stated outcomes.
cards.eligibility: Explicit lineage or reviewed similarity evidence; do not label related work as a failed earlier fix.
cards.destination: Revisit chains and the evidence linking each step.
cards.exploration_value: Helps users see persistent themes across separate conversations.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Materialize follow-up/revisit relations and distinguish continued iteration from recurrence.
cards.calculation_gap: TL1 revisit flags offer a narrow existing view; general reopened work across sources needs explicit links or reviewed similarity.
cards.performance_note: Follow stored lineage when known; similarity retrieval and classification should produce bounded queryable matches.

cards.title: Which parts of the repository are getting new attention?
cards.recipe: Compare per-directory share of reads, edits and conversations with the previous equivalent window; rank meaningful increases and newly active areas.
cards.preview: A small directory map with current and previous intensity.
cards.eligibility: Both windows have usable activity coverage; keep reading and changing distinct.
cards.destination: Directory activity and the conversations driving its change.
cards.exploration_value: Makes emerging project interests and neglected areas discoverable.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Add canonical directory event facts and compatible reading/editing populations.
cards.calculation_gap: Existing path activity can be grouped but directory buckets and current/previous shares are not a complete recipe.
cards.performance_note: Compare timestamp-bounded cohorts or daily directory rollups; keep read and change event types separate.

cards.title: How much am I actually writing?
cards.recipe: Sum estimated typed words by local day; separate pasted, copied, re-sent, template and harness text; optionally split by repository.
cards.preview: Shared Usage columns with typed words emphasized.
cards.eligibility: Authorship estimates exist for observed human messages; label typed-word estimation.
cards.destination: Human Words view and its message provenance.
cards.exploration_value: Makes the user's own contribution visible without mistaking injected text for writing.
cards.current_preview: Words classified as typed or dictated, day by day.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Reuse existing authorship provenance and renderer; integrate the new metric transport for richer charts.
cards.calculation_gap: writing_messages can sum typed_words by day and repository; the current Human Words chart also has a custom series endpoint.
cards.performance_note: Daily authored facts are a good compact source; exact rolling hours need message-time bounds rather than only calendar dates.

cards.title: Where do I spend the most effort explaining?
cards.recipe: Aggregate estimated typed words, genuine human turns and repeat corrections per canonical work; rank repositories and conversations by each measure.
cards.preview: A repository ranking with words and exchanges as distinct marks.
cards.eligibility: Authorship evidence and canonical work joins; call it writing effort, not measured labor time.
cards.destination: High-writing conversations and their human messages.
cards.exploration_value: Shows which tasks demand sustained human explanation.
cards.current_preview: Your typed words across repositories in this window.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Supply correction annotations and work-scoped writing facts with the period applied to constituent messages.
cards.calculation_gap: Typed words and human turns can be grouped now; repeated corrections and canonical work/window facts are not consistently joined.
cards.performance_note: Additive word measures aggregate efficiently; avoid comparing all-time work totals to rolling-period events.

cards.title: Do shorter starting prompts lead to more follow-up?
cards.recipe: Measure genuine initial request length and later human exchanges; compare distributions within repository, task family and model where supported.
cards.preview: A scatter of starting words versus later exchanges, with cohort colors.
cards.eligibility: Enough comparable conversations and complete follow-up; observed association cannot prescribe an ideal prompt length.
cards.destination: Conversations in selected prompt-length cohorts.
cards.exploration_value: Lets users inspect their own prompting tradeoffs.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Create initial-prompt/follow-up facts with task/model/repository cohorts and completion coverage.
cards.calculation_gap: Current writing summaries have overall averages but not the first genuine request plus later exchanges at conversation grain.
cards.performance_note: A prepared conversation source enables v2 scatter/box views; comparable cohorts and selection bias remain outside chart arithmetic.

cards.title: Which examples do I keep supplying?
cards.recipe: Extract human-provided examples, snippets and acceptance criteria; group recurring examples by task topic and source provenance.
cards.preview: An example fragment with repeated-use marks.
cards.eligibility: Retained human-supplied examples and inspectable grouping; do not confuse pasted logs with intentional examples.
cards.destination: Example-bearing messages and later work.
cards.exploration_value: Suggests reusable demonstrations or project guidance.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Annotate example-bearing human spans and cluster recurring examples with source links.
cards.calculation_gap: Provenance can distinguish copied text, but an intentional example or acceptance criterion needs meaning extraction.
cards.performance_note: Store example/cluster memberships keyed by message hash; avoid runtime semantic scans.

cards.title: Which prompts are becoming reusable templates?
cards.recipe: Cluster repeated human starting requests after removing variable paths and identifiers; show stable text and varying parameters.
cards.preview: A prompt with constant text and highlighted variable slots.
cards.eligibility: A stable prompt pattern in several independent launches; preserve authorship and automated-template labels.
cards.destination: Prompt families and their task instances.
cards.exploration_value: Helps users collect workflows they have already invented.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Build deterministic prompt fingerprints plus reviewed semantic families and extracted variable spans.
cards.calculation_gap: Re-sent/template authorship offers candidates, but parameter-normalized reusable prompt families and variable slots are not query fields.
cards.performance_note: Aggregate family memberships; normalization/classification belongs to indexing, not the scalar expression interpreter.

cards.title: Where do I do the final step myself?
cards.recipe: Find explicit human messages stating they performed a fix, command or final integration after agent work; link the preceding obstacle.
cards.preview: Human action quote following a short obstacle chain.
cards.eligibility: Explicit human statement; do not infer actions from a silence or a session ending.
cards.destination: Handoff messages and the preceding attempts.
cards.exploration_value: Finds opportunities for better end-to-end workflows.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Annotate explicit human completion actions and preceding obstacles.
cards.calculation_gap: A human message can be searched literally but does not directly expose an evidenced completed manual final action.
cards.performance_note: Query retained assertions and evidence; absent agent events do not prove the user performed work.

cards.title: How often do I intervene after a long agent run?
cards.recipe: Detect human messages after long sequences of agent actions; categorize clarification, correction, new scope and approval only with reviewed evidence.
cards.preview: A long action strip ending in a human message excerpt.
cards.eligibility: Genuine human messages and sequenced agent events; idle gaps do not measure agent autonomy.
cards.destination: Intervention points and preceding agent runs.
cards.exploration_value: Helps users understand when to provide earlier guidance.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Derive action run lengths and interruption points; classify correction/new scope/approval separately.
cards.calculation_gap: Ordered messages/calls are retained but no action-run-to-human-intervention relation or category exists.
cards.performance_note: Materialize per-stream runs and join bounded human-message facts; idle wall gaps are not autonomous execution time.

cards.title: What can I launch with only a few words?
cards.recipe: Find canonical work with short human launch requests, little later human writing, and explicit recorded completion or feedback; include automated context separately.
cards.preview: A tiny starting prompt alongside the observed result excerpt.
cards.eligibility: Short genuine request plus a supported end state; small input alone does not prove success.
cards.destination: Short-request work with injected context and outcomes visible.
cards.exploration_value: Finds low-friction workflows worth saving and repeating.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose initial request, injected context, later genuine words and explicit observed end-state evidence.
cards.calculation_gap: Work summaries can find little writing, but genuine launch length, later steering and supported completion need a conversation projection.
cards.performance_note: Query prepared work facts with count/coverage thresholds; do not use short total text as a success measure.

cards.title: Which skills am I actually using?
cards.recipe: Group skill evidence by name, distinct agent streams and evidence type; separate explicit invocation, file load and harness load.
cards.preview: Skill names with colored evidence-type marks.
cards.eligibility: At least one retained skill-usage record; listing availability is excluded.
cards.destination: Skill evidence rows and originating messages or calls.
cards.exploration_value: Exposes a capability many users may not know Pharos tracks.
cards.current_preview: Invocations and observed loads; evidence of use, not compliance.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Reuse identity normalization, mirror exclusion and originating-message links.
cards.calculation_gap: skill_usages already groups names, evidence types and distinct conversations with SQL-backed facts.
cards.performance_note: Group date-bounded skill evidence; retained listings must not become usage counts.

cards.title: Which skills travel across projects?
cards.recipe: Count distinct repositories and task families per observed skill; rank breadth and show the specific work where each was loaded.
cards.preview: A skill in the center with several repository spokes.
cards.eligibility: Skill identity resolution and at least two repositories; loading does not prove the instructions were followed.
cards.destination: Cross-repository usage evidence for the skill.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals broadly useful skills already in the user's toolkit.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Add task-family labels only for the richer variant and retain load-versus-following semantics.
cards.calculation_gap: Distinct repositories and streams per skill are available now; task families are optional extra annotations.
cards.performance_note: Use the skill-name/time and conversation indexes; apply cross-repository minimum support before top-K.

cards.title: Which skills appear in low-friction work?
cards.recipe: Compare observed human exchanges, repeated failures and completion evidence in similar task cohorts with and without a skill load; preserve load timing.
cards.preview: Paired distributions with the skill name and sample sizes.
cards.eligibility: Both cohorts have enough comparable work; show association and selection bias rather than skill effectiveness as fact.
cards.destination: Matched work cohorts and skill-load evidence.
cards.exploration_value: Gives users candidates to investigate as useful workflow habits.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Prepare comparable conversation cohorts with skill-load timing, human effort and explicit end-state evidence.
cards.calculation_gap: Skill facts and effort facts exist separately, but matched with/without task cohorts and load timing are not an exposed dataset.
cards.performance_note: Use semi-joins or one-row-per-work flags so skill evidence cannot multiply work usage; don't imply causality.

cards.title: Where do agents fail to load instructions?
cards.recipe: Find failing explicit skill invocations or reads of instruction files; group by skill path, harness and error class.
cards.preview: Instruction path beside the actual failure fragment.
cards.eligibility: Retained failed load event; missing usage records alone are insufficient.
cards.destination: Failed loads, raw results and later recovery attempts.
cards.exploration_value: Finds a fixable reason expected guidance may not reach agents.
cards.current_preview: Skill evidence whose parent call recorded an error.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Hydrate parent call errors and optional harness identity, preserving evidence status.
cards.calculation_gap: Failed skill invocations/loads, paths, provider and status can be filtered now; some precise error details need the originating call.
cards.performance_note: Date/name/status filtering over a small fact table is plausible; absence of evidence is not failed loading.

cards.title: Which workflows reload the same skill?
cards.recipe: Within each stream count repeated observed loads of the same resolved body; compare loaded bytes and event spacing with compaction markers.
cards.preview: Skill-load marks along a session with a compaction notch.
cards.eligibility: Repeated retained load evidence; deduplicate harness attachment snapshots.
cards.destination: Repeat loads and intervening events.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals opportunities to reduce redundant instruction loading.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose deduplicated stream-level body loads and content fingerprints, optionally compaction events.
cards.calculation_gap: Grouping by conversation and skill counts repeats, but exact body identity, stream boundaries and compaction links are missing.
cards.performance_note: Group small load facts by stream/body; use an ordered event join only for timing around compaction.

cards.title: Which MCP methods are becoming useful?
cards.recipe: Rank observed methods by growth in distinct sessions and repositories; include error rates, empty responses and retained result examples.
cards.preview: Method ranking with current and preceding-window activity.
cards.eligibility: Comparable coverage and both windows; label new methods only when prior coverage is adequate.
cards.destination: MCP method calls, arguments and result evidence.
cards.exploration_value: Encourages users to explore capabilities they have started adopting.
cards.current_preview: Recorded method calls across connected tools.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Supply compatible prior-window coverage, response-result counts and bounded examples.
cards.calculation_gap: MCP methods and session/repository counts are available, while period growth and empty-response measures need more facts.
cards.performance_note: Compare indexed MCP-call cohorts and denominators; a method first observed after incomplete capture is not certainly new.

cards.title: Which capabilities do agents keep searching for?
cards.recipe: Find explicit tool-discovery queries and capability requests; cluster requested functions, then connect them to subsequent resolved tool calls where retained.
cards.preview: Capability request leading to the tool ultimately found.
cards.eligibility: Retained discovery arguments or requests; searches alone do not prove a capability is missing.
cards.destination: Discovery episodes, available listings and follow-up calls.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals needs that might benefit from better discovery or reusable guidance.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract discovery episodes and capability labels with linked tool lists and follow-up calls.
cards.calculation_gap: Some discovery arguments are retained, but requested capability classes and subsequent resolution are not fields.
cards.performance_note: Candidate discovery calls can be indexed; classify and link episodes once, then query annotations.

cards.title: What changed after instruction updates?
cards.recipe: Align dated instruction or skill changes with repeated corrections, relevant failures and observed outcomes before and after; use comparable repositories and task populations.
cards.preview: Change marker between two distributions plus one recurring phrase.
cards.eligibility: Dated instruction change and exposure in both periods; causal attribution remains a hypothesis.
cards.destination: Instruction diffs and before-and-after work cohorts.
cards.exploration_value: Connects improvements in guidance to inspectable changes in behavior.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Capture dated instruction changes and prepared compatible task cohorts, using retained change evidence when possible.
cards.calculation_gap: Instruction loads exist but versioned instruction edits and before/after work exposures are not a queryable transition source.
cards.performance_note: Join change anchors to bounded exposures or materialized period facts; concurrent model/task changes need context.

cards.title: Which documentation do agents actually open?
cards.recipe: Rank reached hosts and URLs by distinct conversations; exclude search-result links that were merely returned and never opened.
cards.preview: Domain labels with small visit bars and page-title snippets.
cards.eligibility: Retained tool URL evidence of an actual visit.
cards.destination: Tool calls that reached the selected domains or pages.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals sources the user's agents really consult.
cards.current_preview: Primary recorded hosts on tool calls; open the source URLs.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose reached URL rows with explicit source, parent call/conversation identity and bounded titles/excerpts.
cards.calculation_gap: Primary host/URL counts are available; the whole reached URL population lives in tool_urls and is not a Query Table source.
cards.performance_note: Index host/time and parent identity; count distinct calls/conversations rather than multiplying counts for several URLs in one call.

cards.title: What do agents research repeatedly?
cards.recipe: Normalize web and local search queries; cluster repeats by stable terms and repository; show distinct sessions and the sources subsequently reached.
cards.preview: Repeated search phrase with its source trail.
cards.eligibility: A repeated query family in several sessions; semantic topic labels need inspected examples.
cards.destination: Search episodes and opened sources.
cards.exploration_value: Finds repeated research that may be worth saving as a reusable answer.
cards.current_preview: Exact recorded search queries ranked by frequency.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Normalize query fingerprints, classify richer research topics and link subsequent reached sources.
cards.calculation_gap: Exact repeated search_query counts work; normalized topic families and later sources require extraction/linking.
cards.performance_note: Exact fingerprint repeats can be precomputed cheaply; semantic topic clustering stays a separate cached annotation stage.

cards.title: Have I solved something like this before?
cards.recipe: Match recent task descriptions to earlier similar work inside the rolling window; rank by relevance and explicit resolution evidence rather than recency alone.
cards.preview: Two task fragments with the earlier observed resolution.
cards.eligibility: A supported similarity match and retained earlier outcome; do not promise the solution transfers.
cards.destination: Earlier work, evidence of resolution and the related recent request.
cards.exploration_value: Turns the archive into reusable experience.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Produce a bounded similarity-match relation linked to supported earlier outcomes and relevant passages.
cards.calculation_gap: Semantic search infrastructure exists, but prior-solution relevance and explicit resolution are not metric rows or general formula operators.
cards.performance_note: Use indexed retrieval over versioned documents, then query its result rows; don't run embeddings as aggregate functions.

cards.title: Which decisions did we make and why?
cards.recipe: Extract explicit decisions and the stated rationale; cluster by project area and preserve rejected alternatives with message links.
cards.preview: Decision sentence over a two-branch alternatives sketch.
cards.eligibility: Explicit decision and rationale evidence; proposals remain proposals.
cards.destination: Decision passages and supporting conversation context.
cards.exploration_value: Makes design reasoning easy to recover.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract decision facts with source passages, rationale and proposal-versus-decision status.
cards.calculation_gap: Purpose/outcome summaries do not constitute explicit decision/rationale/alternative records.
cards.performance_note: Incremental evidence extraction makes grouping/filtering ordinary and fast; render a host-owned excerpt cover.

cards.title: What alternatives did we leave unexplored?
cards.recipe: Extract explicitly deferred or rejected approaches; group by reason and connect them to the task they addressed.
cards.preview: Two alternative labels with a short reason excerpt.
cards.eligibility: Explicit alternative and status evidence; silence is not rejection.
cards.destination: Alternative discussions and the original task.
cards.exploration_value: Gives the user a source of ideas when circumstances change.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract alternatives, explicit status, stated reason and task links.
cards.calculation_gap: The archive stores discussions but no deferred/rejected alternative fact table.
cards.performance_note: Store annotations once and fetch bounded source context; silence should not be classified as rejection.

cards.title: What questions remain explicitly open?
cards.recipe: Extract unresolved questions or deferred follow-ups from recent work; scan later retained evidence for an explicit resolution before suggesting.
cards.preview: An open question excerpt with its last observed mention.
cards.eligibility: Explicit open question with no found resolution in available later coverage; keep completeness visible.
cards.destination: Question passages and the later evidence checked.
cards.exploration_value: Helps reconnect loose ends across sessions.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Create question/resolution annotations and a last-checked coverage state.
cards.calculation_gap: Open questions and later resolution links are not exposed, and absence requires later coverage checks.
cards.performance_note: Use incremental follow-up matching or indexed question identities, not repeated scans of every later transcript.

cards.title: Which domains are newly useful to me?
cards.recipe: Compare reached domains with the preceding equivalent window; rank newly observed sources with repeated visits and readable page evidence.
cards.preview: A few domain badges with their first recent visit and topic.
cards.eligibility: New observed domains with enough visits; limited history cannot establish a first-ever visit.
cards.destination: New-source calls and the work that used them.
cards.exploration_value: Introduces useful resources already discovered by the user's agents.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose reached URL/domain facts with first-observed dates and reliable prior-window coverage.
cards.calculation_gap: Primary-domain counts exist, but all reached domains and newly observed comparison need a normalized source and prior coverage.
cards.performance_note: Time/domain indexes plus bounded period differences are suitable; avoid defining first-ever from a partial archive.

cards.title: Where is the same knowledge being rediscovered?
cards.recipe: Link repeated explanations, decisions or research questions across conversations; show evidence of earlier answers and later rediscovery.
cards.preview: Earlier answer and later question joined by a repeated phrase.
cards.eligibility: Several supported knowledge matches; distinguish copied context from independent rediscovery.
cards.destination: Related passages ordered by time with their answers.
cards.exploration_value: Suggests knowledge worth collecting or making easier for agents to retrieve.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Materialize knowledge-topic/passages and earlier-answer-to-later-question links, separate copied context.
cards.calculation_gap: Knowledge equivalence and independent rediscovery cannot be expressed by v2 arithmetic over current tables.
cards.performance_note: Indexed semantic retrieval and cached links make the view queryable; the interpreter should consume those facts.

cards.title: Where does my API-equivalent cost go?
cards.recipe: Aggregate priced usage by day and stable repository, provider, model and flavor dimensions; split token components where recorded.
cards.preview: Shared Usage stacked columns with a consistent category palette.
cards.eligibility: Priced usage in the exact window; show unpriced coverage and avoid calling equivalent cost an invoice.
cards.destination: Usage grouped by the selected dimensions and underlying requests.
cards.exploration_value: Gives users familiar entry points into richer usage exploration.
cards.current_preview: Daily tokens across your repositories.; Recorded usage priced at standard API rates, by repository.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Add a stable flavor join for that variant and use time-grain facts appropriate to exact rolling windows.
cards.calculation_gap: Usage already provides additive token components and API-equivalent prices by session/day/model; flavor is not a current Usage dimension.
cards.performance_note: Current usage construction loads and prices the representative ledger before map filtering; materialized bounded usage/pricing facts will scale better than merely upgrading chart UI.

cards.title: Which sessions are expensive outliers?
cards.recipe: Compute cost per canonical work within comparable repository and task-family cohorts; rank tail observations and show their token and tool composition.
cards.preview: Cost distribution with one session marked and its component strip.
cards.eligibility: Priced work and enough comparable observations to define an outlier; incomplete work is separate.
cards.destination: Expensive work and its usage, tool results and transcript.
cards.exploration_value: Turns an alarming total into concrete sessions users can understand.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Supply task/cohort identity and period-scoped usage facts; expose summed cost per canonical task.
cards.calculation_gap: Library can rank work costs but those are work totals, not per-task totals for only the events inside a rolling window.
cards.performance_note: Group additive usage first, then compute the distribution/threshold; don't histogram session-day-model rows as task costs.

cards.title: Where does prompt caching help most?
cards.recipe: Aggregate eligible input tokens by recorded cache state; compare recorded API-equivalent pricing with an explicit same-workload uncached scenario.
cards.preview: Cached and uncached bands with a scenario difference.
cards.eligibility: Cache-state coverage and compatible versioned rates; cache share alone is not dollar savings.
cards.destination: Usage by cache state and the scenario calculation.
cards.exploration_value: Explains a cost mechanism that is often invisible to users.
cards.current_preview: Recorded cache-read tokens by model; inspect usage details.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Publish cache-state rate components or prepared recorded-versus-uncached scenario fields with pricing coverage.
cards.calculation_gap: Cache shares and historical pricing exist; an explicit compatible uncached workload cost is not a generic measure field.
cards.performance_note: Arithmetic is supported by v2 once rates are available; ratio of sums and priced coverage are necessary for correct aggregation.

cards.title: What would this same usage cost at another price schedule?
cards.recipe: Reprice the same recorded token components with selected historical or current versioned price tables; keep unpriced portions explicit.
cards.preview: Paired cost bars with price dates underneath.
cards.eligibility: Compatible token classes and known rates; this changes prices, not model behavior.
cards.destination: Recorded workload and both price calculations.
cards.exploration_value: Lets users distinguish changes in usage from changes in prices.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Supply compatible versioned rate tables or explicit scenario price fields at the workload grain.
cards.calculation_gap: Historical cost_usd and cost_today_usd already support one comparison; arbitrary selected versioned schedules are additional data/scenario work.
cards.performance_note: Existing historical/today sums can ship now; arbitrary scenarios should reuse workload facts rather than reread and reprice every transcript.

cards.title: How much cost sits inside repeated failure episodes?
cards.recipe: Link normalized failure episodes and recovery attempts to deduplicated attributable usage; show failing attempts, successful recovery and unattributed cost separately.
cards.preview: Cost bands along a retry sequence.
cards.eligibility: Episode boundaries and defensible attribution; do not label all failed work wasted or add overlapping episodes.
cards.destination: Failure episodes, attributed usage and recovery evidence.
cards.exploration_value: Helps users choose which recurring failures are economically worth fixing.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Materialize nonoverlapping episodes and attributable priced usage with explicit unknown or shared portions.
cards.calculation_gap: Failure filters and tool rollup cost exist separately; recovery episode attribution and globally queryable per-call dollars are absent.
cards.performance_note: Episode joins must avoid overlapping counts; query cost facts after attribution, not post-page enrichment.

cards.title: How does recorded usage compare with my subscription?
cards.recipe: Compare recorded API-equivalent usage with a user-provided plan cost for a aligned billing period; show provider coverage and separate services.
cards.preview: Two labeled comparison bands with billing-period dates.
cards.eligibility: User-supplied billing terms and aligned usage; a plan fee and list-price equivalent are different quantities.
cards.destination: Usage included in the comparison and editable billing assumptions.
cards.exploration_value: Answers a common curiosity without pretending usage estimates are bills.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Accept user billing inputs and build a labeled billing-period comparison source.
cards.calculation_gap: Usage estimates exist; subscription billing terms and an aligned comparison period are not archive observations.
cards.performance_note: Generic formulas can divide or compare prepared values; Query Table should not implement provider billing or equate list-price equivalent to an invoice.

cards.title: What changes if I price this workload on a cheaper model?
cards.recipe: Apply alternative model rates to the same classified token workload; break out incompatible or unknown token classes and display an explicit scenario.
cards.preview: Model-colored scenario bars with the unchanged workload labeled.
cards.eligibility: Known compatible rates and token categories; no prediction of quality, token count, latency or actual savings.
cards.destination: Workload components and all scenario assumptions.
cards.exploration_value: Gives users a starting point for model-cost experiments.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Provide versioned compatible rate components and scenario labels, with unsupported token classes visible.
cards.calculation_gap: Alternate model prices and token-class compatibility are not current query fields; no formula predicts changed model behavior.
cards.performance_note: Compute several named scenarios over shared workload facts; changing prices alone does not model quality, token count or latency.

cards.title: How sensitive is estimated energy use to my assumptions?
cards.recipe: Apply configurable energy-per-token, data-center overhead and grid-intensity assumptions to recorded usage; compare plausible user-selected scenarios.
cards.preview: A narrow range band with assumption labels and repository contribution.
cards.eligibility: Recorded tokens and explicit assumption sets; present estimates and sensitivity rather than measured energy.
cards.destination: Token workload and editable energy assumptions.
cards.exploration_value: Makes the environmental view inspectable instead of presenting a falsely precise total.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose the existing model's typed assumptions/components or a prepared sensitivity source with estimate provenance.
cards.calculation_gap: Pharos already has a carbon view and assumptions; scenario-derived energy values are not queryable generic usage measures.
cards.performance_note: The arithmetic is within v2's numeric profile; assumption ownership and ranges belong to Pharos, not a generic energy function.

cards.title: Which models do I use for which work?
cards.recipe: Join model usage to repository, task family and recorded outcome; compare mix and volume while retaining multi-model work explicitly.
cards.preview: Model-by-task mosaic using shared Usage colors.
cards.eligibility: Known model identity and task-family evidence; semantic task labels need classification.
cards.destination: Usage and work in the selected model-task cells.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals the user's actual division of labor across models.
cards.current_preview: Token use by model, day by day.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Build work/model memberships with task labels and explicit multi-model attribution.
cards.calculation_gap: Model/repository usage is available; task-family and recorded outcome joins are not a deduplicated Usage source.
cards.performance_note: Avoid repeating work-level outcomes once per usage row without preserving the intended denominator.

cards.title: Which task families need the least human steering?
cards.recipe: Within comparable task families aggregate genuine human exchanges and explicit end states by model, harness and effort; show distributions and coverage.
cards.preview: Paired exchange distributions with model colors and sample sizes.
cards.eligibility: Comparable cohorts and human authorship evidence; avoid interpreting raw differences as a model leaderboard.
cards.destination: Matched work with steering counts and outcomes.
cards.exploration_value: Helps users explore which configurations fit their own work.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Publish one row per comparable conversation/task with configuration, human exchanges, completion coverage and cohort labels.
cards.calculation_gap: Effort/model data exists in separate grains; comparable task-family cohorts with genuine steering and outcomes are not available.
cards.performance_note: v2 can render scatter/box results over prepared facts; matching cohorts and censoring are Pharos responsibilities.

cards.title: Where do models disagree in parallel attempts?
cards.recipe: Link attempts at the same candidate or request and compare explicitly different diagnoses, proposed solutions or final outcomes.
cards.preview: Two contrasting response fragments with shared task context.
cards.eligibility: A known shared task or candidate identity and evidenced disagreement; unrelated tasks cannot be compared as votes.
cards.destination: All attempts for the candidate and the passages that differ.
cards.exploration_value: Surfaces uncertainty and alternative approaches worth considering.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Extract disagreement facts and paired response passages for known shared candidates.
cards.calculation_gap: TL1 candidate_id links parallel attempts, but semantic disagreement between diagnoses or proposals is not a metric field.
cards.performance_note: Candidate-based matching is cheap; content comparison should be computed/cached outside interactive aggregation.

cards.title: When does escalation change the result?
cards.recipe: Reconstruct explicit configuration-escalation chains; compare observed outcomes and incremental cost at each step by failure family.
cards.preview: A model ladder with outcome marks and cost increments.
cards.eligibility: Recorded lineage and escalation transitions; later success does not prove the initial model was incapable.
cards.destination: Escalation chains with configuration, cost and outcome evidence.
cards.exploration_value: Makes the economics and results of escalation visible.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Materialize candidate escalation edges or episode rows with explicit predecessor/configuration transitions and prices.
cards.calculation_gap: TL1 outcomes/escalated counts provide totals but do not expose ordered escalation chains with incremental cost.
cards.performance_note: Query indexed lineage facts rather than reconstruct every candidate from task history on refresh.

cards.title: Which TL1 configurations advance most often?
cards.recipe: For comparable flavors and candidates compute advances, errors, escalations and revisits per attempt and per candidate; retain execution class and version.
cards.preview: A compact outcome mosaic per configuration.
cards.eligibility: TL1 attempts with dispositions and compatible definitions; do not mix definition revisions or independent and repeated attempts.
cards.destination: Attempt and candidate cohorts with their configurations.
cards.exploration_value: Opens the existing TL1 data to precise reusable questions.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Upgrade map/v2 execution and constrain flavor/definition/execution-class populations; retain explicit per-attempt versus per-candidate measures.
cards.calculation_gap: TL1 attempt, candidate, configuration/version and outcome counters exist; cohort ratios require composed metrics and careful distinct identity.
cards.performance_note: Ratios of sums/distinct candidates are enabled by v2; cached TL1 rows can work until archive size warrants SQL facts.

cards.title: How much work happens in subagents?
cards.recipe: Traverse known parent lineage; aggregate descendant cost, calls and outcomes by depth while counting each stream once; keep unknown lineage separate.
cards.preview: A small branching tree with node sizes proportional to attributed work.
cards.eligibility: Recorded parent-child lineage and deduplicated usage; no addition of rolled-up parent totals to child totals.
cards.destination: Parent and descendant streams with their attributed usage.
cards.exploration_value: Gives delegation a concrete shape beyond a subagent count.
cards.current_preview: Attributed subagent tokens across repositories.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Publish canonical parent-child relations or ancestor memberships and own-stream usage facts.
cards.calculation_gap: Usage session_kind/depth supports breakdowns now, but parent IDs/closure and a tree result are not exposed in the current table.
cards.performance_note: Sum each stream once; a host-precomputed closure avoids arbitrary recursive expression execution and duplicate rolled-up parent cost.

cards.title: Where do delegated agents duplicate effort?
cards.recipe: Within shared parent tasks find repeated same-file reads, equivalent commands and overlapping edits across descendants; show timestamps and task assignments.
cards.preview: Parallel lanes repeating the same file or command.
cards.eligibility: Shared lineage and comparable events; duplication may be intentional validation and should be labeled neutrally.
cards.destination: Child sessions, assignments and repeated events.
cards.exploration_value: Helps inspect whether task boundaries could be clearer.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Expose descendant lineage, normalized actions, assignments and canonical read/edit events.
cards.calculation_gap: Calls can be grouped by path/command, but shared-parent assignments, descendant identity and temporal duplicate episodes are unavailable.
cards.performance_note: Index parent/stream/path/time; candidate matching and interval sweeps should be bounded, with intentional validation distinct from accidental duplication.

cards.title: What changed when I switched configurations?
cards.recipe: Align explicit changes in model, effort, flavor or harness with comparable work; compare token mix, recorded cost, errors and human exchanges across windows.
cards.preview: A change point with a compact set of before-and-after distributions.
cards.eligibility: Known configuration transition and comparable coverage; control task mix or show it prominently.
cards.destination: Work around the transition with configurations and supporting outcomes.
cards.exploration_value: Helps users evaluate their own experiments with evidence rather than memory.
cards.blocked_on_pharos: Supply configuration-change events and matched work facts with token mix and genuine human exchanges.
cards.calculation_gap: Usage has some model/harness version fields; explicit configuration transition anchors and comparable task effort/outcomes are incomplete.
cards.performance_note: Align cohorts and exposure before comparison; composition changes can explain the difference without a configuration effect.

cards.title: When am I writing to agents?
cards.recipe: Bucket genuine human messages and estimated typed words by the user's local day and hour; keep automated activity separate.
cards.preview: A restrained day-by-hour heatmap.
cards.eligibility: Human authorship and timestamps with known timezone; activity is not measured productivity.
cards.destination: Human messages in the selected time buckets.
cards.exploration_value: Reveals the rhythm of the user's participation.
